outcome: correlation of VSBE with Body Attractiveness Questionnaire and Female Sexual Function Index
correlation of VSBE with presence of sutures for perineal laceration
finding: The study found that the VSBE demonstrated good internal consistency, discriminant/construct validity, and reliability, and that VSBE total score and presence of UI were associated with perineal laceration.
mod_finding: Women with perineal laceration after vaginal delivery were older, and had more dyspareunia and previous surgeries than women without perineal laceration.
